quote: I like that the facilitator actually practiced these tips when presenting virtually. I saw some new features to zoom which I hadn't used before such as using stamps. We use Teams here, so it would be great if this could perhaps be done on Teams in future too. I like the tips on using rhetorical questions - this stood out to me and will be using this in future to give myself time to slow down and think, and also to appear confident. Thanks!
author: Amy Sofowora
subject: Virtual Presentation Skills
